items.source: This may be useful for example in mutual TLS authentication where a different RestTemplate for each client certificate such that all calls made through a given RestTemplate instance as associated for the same client identity. HttpClientContext.setUserToken(Object) can be used to specify a fixed user token for all requests.
items.translation: 这在相互 TLS 认证中可能很有用，例如为每个客户端证书使用不同的 RestTemplate，以便通过给定 RestTemplate 实例进行的所有调用都关联到相同的客户端身份。可以使用HttpClientContext.setUserToken(Object)为所有请求指定固定的用户令牌。

items.source: Allows to use a pre-configured HttpClient instance - potentially with authentication, HTTP connection pooling, etc.
items.translation: 允许使用预配置的 HttpClient 实例—— 可能包含身份验证、HTTP 连接池等。

items.source: NOTE: Requires Apache HttpComponents 5.1 or higher.
items.translation: 注意：需要 Apache HttpComponents 5.1 或更高版本。

items.source:
The default implementation tries to merge the defaults of the client
with the local customizations of this factory instance, if any.
items.translation: 默认实现会尝试将客户端的默认值与此工厂实例的本地自定义（如果有）进行合并。

items.source: Merge the given HttpClient-level RequestConfig with the factory-level configuration, if necessary.
items.translation: 合并给定的 HttpClient-级别的 RequestConfig 与工厂级别的配置（如有必要）。
